info.description: ollim — Claude Code token usage telemetry daemon

commands.name: config
commands.description: Open the ollim config file in your default editor.

commands.name: login
commands.description: Authenticate with GitHub to enable leaderboard sharing.

commands.name: logout
commands.description: Revoke GitHub authentication and disable leaderboard sharing.

commands.name: start
commands.description: Register hooks for all supported agents and start tracking token usage.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show current hook status, sharing settings, and pending sync info.

commands.name: stop
commands.description: Unregister hooks for all supported agents and stop tracking token usage.

commands.name: submit
commands.description: Manually flush all pending sessions to the backend.

commands.name: uninstall
commands.description: Remove the hook, config, and all local data.
